name: Cube Sudoku
summary: Cube Sudoku is a logic puzzle game built around six connected 9×9 Sudoku grids on a rotatable cube. Each face follows standard Sudoku rules. Edge cells belong to two faces and corner cells to three, creating one puzzle with 386 unique cells. Players use constraints across neighbouring faces to deduce missing numbers. The game includes five difficulty levels, daily puzzles, pencil notes, undo and redo, explained hints, and VoiceOver support.
